initial.name: jdcloud_lowcode_create
initial.description: Create one form record or start one workflow. Host execution requires addData and rejects values that do not match the live field writeType or omit a required field.

menu_id.description: Exact menuId from the current JDCloud capability snapshot.

auth_group_id.description: Optional JDCloud data-permission group id when the target function requires one.

data.description: Field-code to JSON-value map. Match each field writeType returned by jdcloud_lowcode_describe; single-select values are id strings and multi-select values are arrays of id strings.
